note: Provider-neutral semantics both candidate backends must provide. Identical canonical workload, seeds and fault schedule; identical AgentOS safety semantics (S1-004). Any property not expressible without vendor-specific semantics is unknown and escalates.
shared_semantics: identical task DAG, payload distribution and seeds
side effects only through the policy gateway
retry only with proven idempotency or compensation
unknown external outcome enters reconciliation, never blind retry
checkpoint carries a DB binding and a verified content hash
resume creates a new run with provenance to the previous run
at-least-once delivery never creates a second local effect receipt

in_process.name: In-process scheduler (current AgentOS)
in_process.state: single canonical SQLite (WAL) owned by the coordinator process
in_process.task_queue: in-memory ready queue; durable task/run rows in SQLite
in_process.crash_model: coordinator crash stops everything; committed transitions survive; in-flight tasks restart from checkpoints
in_process.delivery: direct call inside the state owner; outbox drain in-process
in_process.lease: runs carry leases recovered by recover_expired_runs

measured_parameters.note: dispatch from E1 in-process; state write from E2 single-writer txns (1/20587 s); crash recovery modeled from the S1-004 crash-replay probe

durable_engine.name: Durable-execution engine (provider-neutral)
durable_engine.state: event history + task queue in durable storage owned by the engine
durable_engine.dispatch: queue enqueue/dequeue across a process boundary
durable_engine.task_queue: durable queue with visibility timeouts and redelivery
durable_engine.crash_model: engine state survives coordinator worker crashes; in-flight activities are redelivered after lease expiry; completed activities are never re-executed (event history dedup)
durable_engine.delivery: activity commands cross the boundary; outcome recorded as a durable event
durable_engine.lease: activity leases with fencing tokens; stale owners rejected

measured_parameters.note: dispatch from E1 pipe; state write = E2 per-txn cost + one queue/history write; lease timeout and recovery are documented model assumptions (same-host), not vendor measurements
measured_parameters.unknown: multi-host network partition behaviour; vendor-specific timer semantics

reconciliation_contract: an unknown outcome enters reconciling state; resolution (ack/nack) is recorded as evidence before any retry

in_process.rationale: task/run rows and committed transition/outbox state survive coordinator restart, while the ready queue itself is reconstructed rather than durable

durable_engine.rationale: the modeled engine owns durable history and queue state; this is provider-neutral model evidence, not a vendor measurement

in_process.rationale: one coordinator/state boundary and the existing audit surface

durable_engine.rationale: adds an engine history/queue boundary and its operator surface; no vendor implementation is measured

in_process.rationale: current backend; retaining it requires no migration

durable_engine.rationale: provider-neutral boundary is reversible in design, but no migration/rollback drill has been executed
